description: §52.13.2 (S449) — `<program auth="Required">` is an unrecognized literal: W-ATTR-002, and the program applies NO auth gate. The auth lints no longer treat it as a gate — before S449 the auth graph read the raw literal with a `!== "none"` test and emitted W-AUTH-LOGIN-MISSING + I-AUTH-REDIRECT-UNRESOLVED for an app that emits no auth check at all.
rationale: §52.13.2: 'Any literal value not in the recognized set SHALL emit `W-ATTR-002`' … 'On a `<program>`, an unrecognized value applies no auth gate at all'. §52.13 Login-page requirement fires W-AUTH-LOGIN-MISSING only 'When `auth="required"` is declared'.
